proposal_title: Alignment of Handoff Index with Normative Repo Blueprints
domain_specific_rationale: CP-021 removes unsubstantiated and hallucinated technical claims from implementation handoff documents (e.g. AGENT_BUILD_PACKET_INDEX.md), such as non-existent SecretEnclave hardware modules, unratified gRPC ports, or unauthenticated local WebSocket server primitives. From a security assurance perspective, ghost architecture is dangerous because developers and autonomous coding agents might rely on fictitious security boundaries instead of implementing genuine defense-in-depth controls. Aligning the handoff index directly with the 15 normative repository blueprints ensures that agents build against verified, realistic security patterns (OS permissions, in-memory zeroing, and OTel redaction).
evidence_citations: 09_agent_packets/AGENT_BUILD_PACKET_INDEX.md:Lines 1-24 (Accurate alignment of all 15 repositories and their respective normative contract and blueprint schemas)
03_repo_blueprints/R07_PROVIDER_SDK.md:Lines 1-59 (Normative R07 blueprint without phantom enclave dependencies)
capability_impact: Directly safeguards CAP-07 (Security & Isolation) by removing confusing contradictions and preventing autonomous agents from assuming non-existent hardware protections.
residual_risk: Autonomous coding agents executing tasks might query legacy unaligned markdown artifacts if repository caches are uncleared. Mitigation: Build orchestrator must enforce verify_package.py checksum verification and wipe legacy handoff caches prior to agent execution.
